description: "This is a pre-main amplifier that has inherited the tradition since Point One.The power amplifier employs a pure complimentary service OCL stage and a constant current drive class A driver stage. description: "A two way speaker system that uses a sandwich cone.A 17 cm cone type woofer is used for the low range.For the cone, we have adopted a sandwich cone made by sandwiching thin polystyrene cone with uniformly stretched aluminum foil.In addition, it uses a low distortion suspension and a long slow magnet that withstands large amplitude to ensure stable playback even at large input.A 3 cm cone type tweeter is used for the high range.The cone is made of plastic, and by winding a coil directly around the neck of the cone, strain is kept low.The network uses a filter of 18cm/oct. with an emphasis on phase characteristics in the mid-range."
